summary: torch_tpu is an open‑source native PyTorch backend that enables efficient execution of models on Google TPUs. It is packaged on PyPI and provides both a Python API and CLI scripts, allowing developers to run PyTorch workloads directly on TPU hardware. The tool is most useful for researchers and engineers who need TPU acceleration without the overhead of XLA layers. While it shows promising speed numbers (1 ms import) and has an active contributor base, its test suite currently fails all checks, indicating limited ready‑to‑use reliability.
